summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of treasury shares on the Euronext Milan from 8 to 12 June 2026. The company acquired 4,262,491 shares (0.14% of share capital) at a weighted average price of €23.4605 per share, total consideration €99,999,976. These purchases are part of a second tranche buyback program approved by shareholders on 6 May 2026, intended to provide additional remuneration beyond dividends. Since the program's start on 8 May 2026, Eni has bought 15,445,138 shares (0.51% of capital) for €359.9 million, now holding 3.38% of share capital. No advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. What to watch: programme execution pace and impact on earnings per share.
